name: Nikos Georgopoulos Ninos
title: Software Engineer
intro: I am a passionate technology enthusiast who thrives on exploring new technological advancements, programming languages and innovative tools. I am eager to leverage my skills to contribute effectively to dynamic projects, and I excel at generating creative ideas that drive solutions and foster growth.

paragraphs: I am a passionate technology enthusiast who thrives on exploring new technological advancements. I have a keen interest in learning and adopting new technologies, programming languages, and innovative tools.

My continuous drive to expand my knowledge keeps me engaged and excited about the ever-evolving tech landscape. I am committed to staying at the forefront of technological developments and eager to leverage my skills to contribute effectively to dynamic projects.

keyCharacteristic.label: My key characteristic
keyCharacteristic.text: I excel at generating innovative and creative ideas that drive solutions, enhance strategies, and foster growth.

seo.description: Nikos Georgopoulos Ninos, software engineer based in Athens. CV and portfolio with Oracle OSM telecom integrations, IoT platforms, data mining and forecasting.

_notes: site: stats - old hard-coded numbers were Projects 8 / Technologies 10 / Customers 3 / Certifications 6. New values are derived from data and two of them differ: Projects 8 -> 9 (number of project files; 9 project pages exist on the old site, the old counter said 8) and Technologies 10 -> 16 (number of visible skills). Certifications stays 6 (number of certificates). Customers stays at 3 as on the old site. To keep an old number, replace the 'auto:...' value in the stats list with a plain number.

experience: the old page placed Cognity and INDUST in the left column and Pobuca in the right; order is now strictly newest first (Cognity, INDUST, Pobuca). Location taken from the old italic company line.

education: GPA / Degree stored as grade strings '3.15 / 4 GPA' and '7.5 / 10'. M.Sc. period 'September 2022 - April 2024' and B.Sc. period 'October 2016 - July 2022' normalised to an en dash. education: B.Sc. thesis text kept verbatim (line break inside the old markup normalised to a single space); the school name and location were split from the old two-line italic block.
education: order is newest first (M.Sc. then B.Sc.); the old page showed M.Sc. left and B.Sc. right, same order.

certificates: the Cybersecurity description is a sentence fragment in the original ('Company's resilience against cyber threats, ...') and was kept as is.
